lead.headline: Down 16.5 before your first snap; Tuten still unseen
lead.deck: Watson scored for Footballers and left with a concussion. Tuten and Likely have no new practice reports; both Sunday fallbacks stand.
lead.body: Bad news first. Nothing improved overnight for Bhayshul Tuten or Isaiah Likely: Tuten's last practice report is Wednesday's DNP, Likely's a limited Wednesday, and Thursday's reports arrive this afternoon. Stefon Diggs missed Wednesday for a personal reason. Footballers already lead 16.5 to 0 — Christian Watson scored it at Los Angeles before leaving at halftime with a concussion. Josh Allen plays Kansas City tonight; Footballers have Caleb Williams at Detroit at noon. The plan for Sunday 10:30 is unchanged: if Tuten sits, Travis Etienne Jr. takes the seat; if Likely sits, add T.J. Hockenson, now a free agent, and drop Etienne. ESPN gives you 48%.

doFirst.headline: Two decisions, made in advance
doFirst.deck: Tuten's and Likely's fallbacks, checked Sunday 10:30.
doFirst.note: Nothing to move today: the lineup is the projection lineup. If Tuten sits, start Etienne; if Likely sits, add Hockenson (or Okonkwo) and drop Etienne.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to move this morning: the lineup is the projection lineup and Allen plays tonight.

wire.deck: Every name on this morning's screen comes from the one game played, Green Bay at Los Angeles, and all pass. Hockenson is the only wire name that matters — and only if Likely sits.
